determinism: every timestamp and run identifier is supplied here; the tool reads no clock
note: The final discovery runner has no committed output schema in this repository as of 2026-08-13. This is the shape scripts/concept_bundle_publish.py accepts. Every object is closed: unknown fields are refused so that a rename cannot silently drop a value. Amend this file and the validator together.

targets.note: sae_id and layer come from `pairing`, so every target is on one SAE at one layer by construction

directions.note: one calibrated direction is sufficient; do not manufacture suppress if only amplify validates

causal_validation.computed_at_commit: strict descendant; an equal commit fails

gates.note: the gate identifiers and their MEANINGS are the Architect's and are defined nowhere in this repository. This tool requires each to be present, named, 'pass' and evidenced; it does not define or compute what any of them measures.
gates.type: array of {gate, status, evidence, family_id?, direction?, statistic?}

judge.note: G-D and G-E are judged gates. A no-op identity records that no judge ran, which is not a judged result, so it is refused rather than accepted as one.

concept.hypothesis_source: free text. A legacy concept NAME may be reused as a hypothesis; nothing else legacy may be reused.

configuration.grid_cells_recorded: must equal grid_cells_expected when completeness is COMPLETE: the absence of an exception is not completeness
configuration.layer: must equal the frozen configuration's layer for this pairing; a third layer is prohibited
configuration.model_n_layers: the loaded model's real layer count. depth = layer / model_n_layers is recomputed and must match the configuration's depth_fraction
name: primary
backup
configuration.namespace: bundles are written to <out-dir>/<name>/<concept>__<pairing>.json, so primary and backup can never resolve to one file

discovery.engineering_index_rediscovery_note: REQUIRED when (layer, feature_idx) matches a known mechanical-acceptance input: gemma: ((31, 250),); qwen: ((0, 4096),)

dose_response.observations: every dose that was run, including ones the calibration did not select
dose_response.strength_mapping: must EQUAL calibration.directions.<d>.strengths; the dose that ships must be the dose that was measured

layer_selection.required_when: the pairing has no ruled sae_id (Qwen)

pairing.params_expected_sha256: REFUSED in this document. The expected digest is read from the identity artifact; a producer emitting it would hand back a copy of the value it is meant to be checked against, and the comparison would pass against itself
pairing.params_sha256: the MEASURED SHA-256, hashed from the params file the run actually loaded. It must equal the AUTHORITATIVE EXPECTED digest frozen as params_expected_sha256 in the identity artifact; mismatch is a hard stop. Required and non-null on the Gemma arm, where an expected digest exists. May be null only on the Qwen arm, which the identity artifact freezes no SAE for, and there it is carried rather than verified
pairing.sae_identity_note: Availability is decided by all five together. repository_id is sae_repo_id, revision is sae_repo_revision, and scientific_sae_id is sae_id -- the contract's frozen name for it. release and loader_sae_id are recorded alongside because a flat loader key is meaningful only inside its release namespace: the same string can exist in two releases and resolve to different weights.

positions.disclosure: GENERATED_ONLY masks prefill and leaves the first generated token unaffected.

prompt_set.source_commit: 40 hex; must be a STRICT git ancestor of causal_validation.computed_at_commit
prompt_set.source_path: repo-relative, tracked and CLEAN; a dirty working copy fails
prompt_set.source_sha256: sha256 of the file's bytes AS COMMITTED at source_commit; checked against the blob

subject.local_refs: a local:registry/... ref must resolve and content-verify

validation.note: copied verbatim into feature_certificate.payload and validated against schemas/feature_certificate/v1.schema.json by interplab.registry.put

additional.feature_certificate: the concept-validation instruments and the green/amber/red verdict (specificity, sensitivity, selectivity, probe). Retained alongside the four because 'we probed it and it holds up' is a different claim from 'we searched and this surfaced' and from 'intervening on it did something', and the publication gate reads its verdict

binding.causal_validation_record: the protocol gates G-A..G-E asserted against the sealed prompt set, bound to it by both its digest and its commit
binding.discovery_record: how the candidate was FOUND on this pairing: scope, ranking, the explicit rediscovery declaration, the layer selection
binding.dose_response_record: the measured dose-response the Low/Medium/High mapping was read off, one record per calibrated direction
binding.prompt_set_record: the prompts, fixed and committed BEFORE any activation was computed; the chronology anchor every other record is ordered against

sealed_artifacts.note: four separate artifact_types, not one composite: no claim may be read off a record that did not make it

status: DECLARED BY ENGINEER 3, AWAITING ENGINEER 1 RATIFICATION
strictness: all objects closed; no field has a default; null is never a substitute for a value
